chosen_moment.description: Dirt-bike rider jumps a moving elevated train in broad daylight (Launch Trailer 48.8-51.6s): takeoff off the train track, rider + red dirt bike hang in mid-air above the train, then lands and rides away. The single most jaw-dropping stunt in the trailer — it reads in one second with the sound off, which is what a Shorts hook needs.
chosen_moment.why_this_moment: The bike-over-train jump is the only beat in either trailer that is (a) a pure stunt with a clear impossible-looking payoff, (b) fully visible in a vertical crop (rider centered, sky behind), and (c) instantly legible without sound or context. The biplane wing-walker is the runner-up but the walker is small in frame; the helicopter glass-smash is night-dark and reads worse at phone size. The jump opens the clip (hook first), gets a slow-mo replay, then the montage proves GTA 6 is wall-to-wall chaos.
